title: A fuzz test
hints: A fuzz function gets inputs it has never seen, so it can't compare against a fixed `want`. It checks **properties** instead: facts that are true for every correct answer. Reversing twice gives the original back, for example.

Each property catches different bugs. A byte-wise reverse passes the round trip but breaks UTF-8 on `"héllo"`. A function that leaves the first rune in place also passes the round trip, but its output starts with the wrong rune. Your seeds must include text where these bugs show: spaces and multi-byte runes.
